facts.subject: Certain equipment and materials
facts.evidence: Certain equipment and materials that are used in the manufacture of our products are available only from a limited number of suppliers, or in some cases, a sole supplier.

facts.subject: suppliers to provide the majority of certain types of IC packages
facts.evidence: We also depend on a limited number of suppliers to provide the majority of certain types of IC packages for our microprocessors, including our APU products.

facts.subject: certain non-proprietary materials or components
facts.evidence: Similarly, certain non-proprietary materials or components such as memory, printed circuit boards (PCBs), interposers, substrates and capacitors used in the manufacture of our products are currently available from only a limited number of suppliers.

facts.subject: customer

facts.subject: One Client and Gaming segment customer
facts.evidence: One Client and Gaming segment customer accounted for 18 % of consolidated net revenue in fiscal year 2023.
